-- =============================================================================
-- FINAL CONSOLIDATED BIGQUERY SQL
-- Artifact: CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_version       STRING  - Budget version (e.g., 'LEDGER_BUD'); passed to
--                               CV_BASE_FIN_WEEKLY_BUDGET_S4 as IP_VERSION /
--                               IP_FC_COUNT logic and to COMP_FLAG filter
--   @ip_week_ending_from STRING - Start week (bic_zio_sweek range lower bound)
--   @ip_week_ending_to   STRING - End week (bic_zio_sweek range upper bound)
--   @ip_fc_count         STRING - Frozen Cube Count derived from
--                               SFN_FC_FLAG(@ip_version); unresolved scalar
--                               function replaced with runtime parameter.
--                               '0' = use Live_Cube; non-'0' = use Frozen_Cube.
--   @v_week              STRING - Prior fiscal week derived from
--                               SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK(); unresolved scalar
--                               function replaced with runtime parameter.
--                               Used to filter ZTSRP_COMPFL rows loaded into
--                               TBL_WSS_SRP_COMPFLAG by STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES.
-- =============================================================================

WITH
WEEKDATES AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(CURR.RCLNT AS STRING)      AS MANDT,
        CAST(PREV.ZZWEEK AS STRING)     AS PREV_WEEK_NBR,
        CAST(PREV.ZRWSTRTDATE AS DATE)  AS PREV_WEEK_START,
        CAST(PREV.ZRWENDDATE AS DATE)   AS PREV_WEEK_END,
        CAST(LY.ZZWEEK AS STRING)       AS LY_WEEK_NBR,
        CAST(LY.ZRWSTRTDATE AS DATE)    AS LY_WEEK_START,
        CAST(LY.ZRWENDDATE AS DATE)     AS LY_WEEK_END
    FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek` AS CURR
    /* Current week: fiscal date table, today's date */
    INNER JOIN `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_finsc_fisc_date` AS B
        ON CAST(CURR.ZRWSTRTDATE AS DATE) = CAST(B.FISCAL_WEEK_START_DATE AS DATE)
       AND B.FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT = 'K4'
       AND CAST(B.CALENDAR_DATE AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE('America/New_York')
    /* Previous week of the current week */
    LEFT JOIN `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek` AS PREV
        ON CAST(PREV.RCLNT AS STRING) = CAST(CURR.RCLNT AS STRING)
       AND CAST(PREV.ZRWENDDATE AS DATE) =
           DATE_SUB(CAST(CURR.ZRWSTRTDATE AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    /* Last-year previous week: fiscal date table, today - 1 year - 7 days */
    LEFT JOIN `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_finsc_fisc_date` AS B_LY
        ON B_LY.FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT = 'K4'
       AND CAST(B_LY.CALENDAR_DATE AS DATE) =
           DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('America/New_York'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    LEFT JOIN `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek` AS LY
        ON CAST(LY.RCLNT AS STRING) = CAST(CURR.RCLNT AS STRING)
       AND CAST(LY.ZRWSTRTDATE AS DATE) = CAST(B_LY.FISCAL_WEEK_START_DATE AS DATE)
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY CAST(CURR.RCLNT AS STRING)
        ORDER BY CAST(CURR.ZRWSTRTDATE AS DATE) DESC,
                 CAST(CURR.ZZWEEK AS STRING) DESC
    ) = 1
),
   --IP Count calculation
FC_CONTROL AS (
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS IP_FC_COUNT
FROM
`edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds202` f
INNER JOIN (
SELECT DISTINCT
PREV_WEEK_NBR
FROM WEEKDATES
WHERE PREV_WEEK_NBR IS NOT NULL
) w
ON CAST(f.bic_zio_sweek AS STRING) = w.PREV_WEEK_NBR
WHERE
f.bic_zio_ver = 'LEDGER_BUD'
),
-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: Frozen_Cube
-- Logic: Reads weekly budget data from the Frozen Cube source table
--        (AZSRP_DS052_VT_S4). Active only when @ip_fc_count != '0'.
--        Adds constant FLAG = 'FC'. Remaps physical column names to
--        BigQuery mapped names. mandt is STRING per Columns_Mapping.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds202
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200') AND @ip_fc_count != '0'
-- =====================================================================
Frozen_Cube AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    recordmode,
    currency,
    b631_s_amount,
    bic_zio_amt,
    'FC' AS flag
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds202`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND (SELECT FC_CONTROL.IP_FC_COUNT FROM FC_CONTROL) != 0
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: Live_Cube
-- Logic: Reads weekly budget data from the Live Cube source table
--        (AZSRP_DS041_VT_S4). Active only when @ip_fc_count = '0'.
--        Adds constant FLAG = 'LC'. Remaps bic_zio_pctr -> b631_s_proftctr
--        and bic_zio_cctr -> b631_s_costcntr per source CV logic.
--        mandt is STRING per Columns_Mapping.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds041
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200') AND @ip_fc_count = '0'
-- =====================================================================
Live_Cube AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    bic_zio_pctr        AS b631_s_proftctr,
    bic_zio_cctr        AS b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    recordmode,
    currency,
    b631_s_amount,
    bic_zio_amt,
    'LC' AS flag
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds041`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND (SELECT FC_CONTROL.IP_FC_COUNT FROM FC_CONTROL) = 0
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: Aggregated_Weekly_Budget_Snapshot
-- Logic: Unions Frozen_Cube and Live_Cube, then aggregates to compute
--        SUM(_b631_s_amount) per FLAG and SUM(bic_zio_amt). Preserves
--        FLAG column for the downstream FC/LC precedence calculation.
--        This is the intermediate aggregation stage of
--        CV_BASE_FIN_WEEKLY_BUDGET_S4 (CUBE/Aggregation).
-- Source: Frozen_Cube UNION ALL Live_Cube
-- Aggregation: GROUP BY all non-measure columns including flag;
--              SUM(b631_s_amount) AS b631_s_amount_dummy, SUM(bic_zio_amt)
-- =====================================================================
Aggregated_Weekly_Budget_Snapshot AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    recordmode,
    currency,
    flag,
    SUM(b631_s_amount) AS b631_s_amount_dummy,
    SUM(bic_zio_amt)   AS bic_zio_amt
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM Frozen_Cube
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM Live_Cube
  )
  GROUP BY
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    recordmode,
    currency,
    flag
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05
-- Logic: Applies the CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC consumer-level filters to
--        the CV_BASE_FIN_WEEKLY_BUDGET_S4 output. Computes the final
--        b631_s_amount using FC/LC precedence:
--        IF(RES_AMOUNT_FC IS NULL, RES_AMOUNT_LC, RES_AMOUNT_FC).
--        Also projects b631_s_amount_negative = b631_s_amount (the raw
--        pre-negation value passed forward; negation applied in FLAGS CTE).
-- Source: Aggregated_Weekly_Budget_Snapshot
-- Filters: fiscvarnt = 'K4'
--          AND bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
--          AND bic_zio_ver = @ip_version
--          AND bic_zio_saudt IN ('1','10')
-- Calculation: b631_s_amount = IF(fc_amt IS NULL, lc_amt, fc_amt)
-- =====================================================================
WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    recordmode,
    currency,
    -- FC/LC precedence: IF(RES_AMOUNT_FC IS NULL, RES_AMOUNT_LC, RES_AMOUNT_FC)
    IF(
      MAX(CASE WHEN flag = 'FC' THEN b631_s_amount_dummy END) IS NULL,
      MAX(CASE WHEN flag = 'LC' THEN b631_s_amount_dummy END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN flag = 'FC' THEN b631_s_amount_dummy END)
    ) AS b631_s_amount_negative,
    SUM(bic_zio_amt) AS bic_zio_amt,
    -- FLAG column: use FC flag value if present, else LC
    MAX(CASE WHEN flag = 'FC' THEN flag ELSE NULL END) AS flag_fc,
    MAX(flag) AS flag
  FROM
    Aggregated_Weekly_Budget_Snapshot
  WHERE
    fiscvarnt = 'K4'
    AND bic_zio_sweek =(Select WEEKDATES.PREV_WEEK_NBR from WEEKDATES)
    AND bic_zio_ver = 'LEDGER_BUD'
    AND bic_zio_saudt IN ('1', '10')
  GROUP BY
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    recordmode,
    currency
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: HIER_NODE
-- Logic: Filters HRRP_NODE hierarchy to rows where PARNODE ends with
--        'CORE_RET' and HRYVALTO = '9999-12-31' (mapped DATE).
--        Provides NODEVALUE for profit-center join.
--        mandt is STRING per Columns_Mapping; hryvalto is DATE.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
--          AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'CORE_RET$')
--          AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
-- =====================================================================
HIER_NODE AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    nodevalue
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'CORE_RET$')
    AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: Join_1 / ONLY_CORE_RET_DATA
-- Logic: INNER JOIN of WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 and HIER_NODE on
--        b631_s_proftctr = nodevalue. Retains only profit centers that
--        belong to the CORE_RET hierarchy node. Brings in parnode.
--        ONLY_CORE_RET_DATA is a pass-through of Join_1; combined here.
-- Source: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 INNER JOIN HIER_NODE
-- Join: INNER JOIN on ws.b631_s_proftctr = hn.nodevalue
-- =====================================================================
ONLY_CORE_RET_DATA AS (
  SELECT
    ws.fiscper,
    ws.fiscvarnt,
    ws.bic_zio_sweek,
    ws.fiscyear,
    ws.fiscper3,
    ws.b631_s_chrtacct,
    ws.b631_s_gl_acct,
    ws.b631_s_co_area,
    ws.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    ws.b631_s_proftctr,
    ws.b631_s_costcntr,
    ws.b631_s_funcarea,
    ws.bic_zio_ver,
    ws.bic_zio_saudt,
    ws.mandt,
    ws.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    ws.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    ws.recordmode,
    ws.currency,
    ws.b631_s_amount_negative,
    ws.bic_zio_amt,
    ws.flag,
    hn.parnode
  FROM
    WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 ws
    INNER JOIN HIER_NODE hn
      ON ws.b631_s_proftctr = hn.nodevalue
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL (inline expansion of CV_COMP_MD_SRPACT_STATIC)
-- Logic: Reads store attribute data from TBL_WSS_SRP_ATTR_ACT (populated
--        by STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES from ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT with no week
--        filter). CV_COMP_MD_SRPACT_STATIC is a CUBE/Aggregation over
--        TBL_WSS_SRP_ATTR_ACT; TBL_WSS_SRP_ATTR_ACT is populated from
--        CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4 which reads ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT filtered to
--        mandt IN ('120','200'). The procedure inserts all rows from
--        CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4 (no week filter for ATTR table).
--        Columns mapped via Columns_Mapping for ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT.
--        mandt is STRING per Columns_Mapping.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- Aggregation: GROUP BY all non-measure attributes; SUM measures
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    kokrs,
    kostl,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_close_dat,
    fs_open_dat,
    fs_close_dat,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zipcode,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    division_mgr,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    area_mgr,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    region_mgr,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zone_code,
    district_mgr,
    zone_desc,
    major_region_code,
    major_region,
    store_type,
    store_type_desc,
    rx_store_desc,
    distribution_cntr,
    distribution_cntr_desc,
    store_24_hr,
    budget_open_dat,
    budget_closed_dat,
    budget_reloc_dat,
    const_open_dat,
    const_close_dat,
    const_relo_dat,
    relocation_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    budget_emerg_mkt_ind,
    company_code,
    company_code_desc,
    original_fs_open_dat,
    original_rx_open_dat,
    group_one,
    group_two,
    ard_sort_key,
    area_cost_center,
    regiion_cost_center,
    county_code,
    county_desc,
    sqft_bracket_desc,
    sqft_sort_key,
    acquisition_code,
    acquisition_desc,
    photo_lab_add_dat,
    photo_lab_close_dat,
    min_hrs_ind,
    createdby,
    created_on,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    SUM(rx_hrs_oper)      AS rx_hrs_oper,
    SUM(fs_hrs_oper)      AS fs_hrs_oper,
    SUM(rx_store)         AS rx_store,
    SUM(retail_sqft_amt)  AS retail_sqft_amt,
    SUM(total_sqft_amt)   AS total_sqft_amt
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
  GROUP BY
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    kokrs,
    kostl,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_close_dat,
    fs_open_dat,
    fs_close_dat,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zipcode,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    division_mgr,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    area_mgr,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    region_mgr,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zone_code,
    district_mgr,
    zone_desc,
    major_region_code,
    major_region,
    store_type,
    store_type_desc,
    rx_store_desc,
    distribution_cntr,
    distribution_cntr_desc,
    store_24_hr,
    budget_open_dat,
    budget_closed_dat,
    budget_reloc_dat,
    const_open_dat,
    const_close_dat,
    const_relo_dat,
    relocation_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    budget_emerg_mkt_ind,
    company_code,
    company_code_desc,
    original_fs_open_dat,
    original_rx_open_dat,
    group_one,
    group_two,
    ard_sort_key,
    area_cost_center,
    regiion_cost_center,
    county_code,
    county_desc,
    sqft_bracket_desc,
    sqft_sort_key,
    acquisition_code,
    acquisition_desc,
    photo_lab_add_dat,
    photo_lab_close_dat,
    min_hrs_ind,
    createdby,
    created_on,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: Join_2
-- Logic: LEFT JOIN of ONLY_CORE_RET_DATA with STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL on
--        b631_s_proftctr = prctr. Enriches budget rows with store
--        attribute dimensions. CAL_STORE_WEEK_NUMBER calculation
--        (WEEK_NUMBER node) is combined here as it is a simple projection.
-- Source: ONLY_CORE_RET_DATA LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on ocrd.b631_s_proftctr = saa.prctr
-- Calculation: RIGHT(bic_zio_sweek, 2) AS cal_store_week_number
-- =====================================================================
Join_2 AS (
  SELECT
    ocrd.fiscper,
    ocrd.fiscvarnt,
    ocrd.bic_zio_sweek,
    ocrd.fiscyear,
    ocrd.fiscper3,
    ocrd.b631_s_chrtacct,
    ocrd.b631_s_gl_acct,
    ocrd.b631_s_co_area,
    ocrd.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    ocrd.b631_s_proftctr,
    ocrd.b631_s_costcntr,
    ocrd.b631_s_funcarea,
    ocrd.bic_zio_ver,
    ocrd.bic_zio_saudt,
    ocrd.mandt,
    ocrd.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    ocrd.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    ocrd.recordmode,
    ocrd.currency,
    ocrd.b631_s_amount_negative,
    ocrd.bic_zio_amt,
    ocrd.flag,
    ocrd.parnode,
    saa.strnum,
    saa.rep_mkt_code,
    saa.rep_mkt_desc,
    saa.emerg_mkt_ind,
    saa.division_code,
    saa.division_desc,
    saa.area_code,
    saa.area_desc,
    saa.district_code,
    saa.district_desc,
    saa.region_code,
    saa.region_desc,
    saa.city,
    saa.state,
    saa.fs_open_dat,
    saa.rx_open_dat,
    saa.rx_division_code,
    saa.rx_area_code,
    saa.rx_region_code,
    saa.rx_district_code,
    -- WEEK_NUMBER node: CAL_STORE_WEEK_NUMBER = RIGHTSTR(_BIC_ZIO_SWEEK, 2)
    RIGHT(ocrd.bic_zio_sweek, 2) AS cal_store_week_number
  FROM
    ONLY_CORE_RET_DATA ocrd
    LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL saa
      ON ocrd.b631_s_proftctr = saa.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: COMP_FLAG_BUDGET (inline expansion of CV_COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC)
-- Logic: Reads comp flag data from TBL_WSS_SRP_COMPFLAG (populated by
--        STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES from ZTSRP_COMPFL filtered to
--        zweek = @v_week). CV_COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC is a simple
--        projection over TBL_WSS_SRP_COMPFLAG. The procedure's filter
--        zweek = @v_week is preserved here as it was applied during the
--        INSERT. CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC adds filter COMP_VER = @ip_version.
--        mandt is STRING per Columns_Mapping; zweek is STRING.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200') [from CV_BASE_MD_COMPFL_S4]
--          AND zweek = @v_week [from STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES INSERT filter]
--          AND comp_ver = @ip_version [from CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC]
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG_BUDGET AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    strnum,
    comp_ver,
    zweek,
    zmonth,
    zyear,
    fs_comp_pre,
    rx_comp_pre,
    fs_comp_mon,
    rx_comp_mon,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND zweek = (Select WEEKDATES.PREV_WEEK_NBR from WEEKDATES)
    AND comp_ver = 'LEDGER_BUD'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: Join_3
-- Logic: LEFT JOIN of Join_2 with COMP_FLAG_BUDGET on
--        (b631_s_proftctr = prctr AND bic_zio_sweek = zweek).
--        Brings in fs_comp_wk and rx_comp_wk for comp flag calculation.
-- Source: Join_2 LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_BUDGET
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j2.b631_s_proftctr = cfb.prctr
--       AND j2.bic_zio_sweek = cfb.zweek
-- =====================================================================
Join_3 AS (
  SELECT
    j2.fiscper,
    j2.fiscvarnt,
    j2.bic_zio_sweek,
    j2.fiscyear,
    j2.fiscper3,
    j2.b631_s_chrtacct,
    j2.b631_s_gl_acct,
    j2.b631_s_co_area,
    j2.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j2.b631_s_proftctr,
    j2.b631_s_costcntr,
    j2.b631_s_funcarea,
    j2.bic_zio_ver,
    j2.bic_zio_saudt,
    j2.mandt,
    j2.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    j2.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    j2.recordmode,
    j2.currency,
    j2.b631_s_amount_negative,
    j2.bic_zio_amt,
    j2.flag,
    j2.parnode,
    j2.strnum,
    j2.rep_mkt_code,
    j2.rep_mkt_desc,
    j2.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j2.division_code,
    j2.division_desc,
    j2.area_code,
    j2.area_desc,
    j2.district_code,
    j2.district_desc,
    j2.region_code,
    j2.region_desc,
    j2.city,
    j2.state,
    j2.fs_open_dat,
    j2.rx_open_dat,
    j2.rx_division_code,
    j2.rx_area_code,
    j2.rx_region_code,
    j2.rx_district_code,
    j2.cal_store_week_number,
    cfb.fs_comp_wk,
    cfb.rx_comp_wk
  FROM
    Join_2 j2
    LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_BUDGET cfb
      ON j2.b631_s_proftctr = cfb.prctr
     AND j2.bic_zio_sweek    = cfb.zweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: CAL_WEEK (inline expansion of CV_BASE_MD_RCALWEEK_S4)
-- Logic: Projects calendar week reference data from ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK.
--        rclnt is STRING per Columns_Mapping; zzweek is STRING.
--        Filtered to rclnt IN ('120','200').
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
CAL_WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    zzweek,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate,
    rclnt
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE
    rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 12: Join_4
-- Logic: LEFT JOIN of Join_3 with CAL_WEEK on bic_zio_sweek = zzweek.
--        Brings in zrwstrtdate and zrwenddate (week start/end dates).
-- Source: Join_3 LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j3.bic_zio_sweek = cw.zzweek
-- =====================================================================
Join_4 AS (
  SELECT
    j3.fiscper,
    j3.fiscvarnt,
    j3.bic_zio_sweek,
    j3.fiscyear,
    j3.fiscper3,
    j3.b631_s_chrtacct,
    j3.b631_s_gl_acct,
    j3.b631_s_co_area,
    j3.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j3.b631_s_proftctr,
    j3.b631_s_costcntr,
    j3.b631_s_funcarea,
    j3.bic_zio_ver,
    j3.bic_zio_saudt,
    j3.mandt,
    j3.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    j3.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    j3.recordmode,
    j3.currency,
    j3.b631_s_amount_negative,
    j3.bic_zio_amt,
    j3.flag,
    j3.parnode,
    j3.strnum,
    j3.rep_mkt_code,
    j3.rep_mkt_desc,
    j3.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j3.division_code,
    j3.division_desc,
    j3.area_code,
    j3.area_desc,
    j3.district_code,
    j3.district_desc,
    j3.region_code,
    j3.region_desc,
    j3.city,
    j3.state,
    j3.fs_open_dat,
    j3.rx_open_dat,
    j3.rx_division_code,
    j3.rx_area_code,
    j3.rx_region_code,
    j3.rx_district_code,
    j3.cal_store_week_number,
    j3.fs_comp_wk,
    j3.rx_comp_wk,
    cw.zrwstrtdate,
    cw.zrwenddate
  FROM
    Join_3 j3
    LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK cw
      ON j3.bic_zio_sweek = cw.zzweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 13: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT (inline expansion of CV_BASE_MD_CEPCT_S4)
-- Logic: Projects profit center text from CEPCT. mandt is STRING per
--        Columns_Mapping. ltext aliased to profit_center_text as defined
--        by the consumer CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 14: Join_5
-- Logic: LEFT JOIN of Join_4 with PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT on
--        b631_s_proftctr = prctr. Brings in profit_center_text.
-- Source: Join_4 LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j4.b631_s_proftctr = pct.prctr
-- =====================================================================
Join_5 AS (
  SELECT
    j4.fiscper,
    j4.fiscvarnt,
    j4.bic_zio_sweek,
    j4.fiscyear,
    j4.fiscper3,
    j4.b631_s_chrtacct,
    j4.b631_s_gl_acct,
    j4.b631_s_co_area,
    j4.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j4.b631_s_proftctr,
    j4.b631_s_costcntr,
    j4.b631_s_funcarea,
    j4.bic_zio_ver,
    j4.bic_zio_saudt,
    j4.mandt,
    j4.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    j4.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    j4.recordmode,
    j4.currency,
    j4.b631_s_amount_negative,
    j4.bic_zio_amt,
    j4.flag,
    j4.parnode,
    j4.strnum,
    j4.rep_mkt_code,
    j4.rep_mkt_desc,
    j4.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j4.division_code,
    j4.division_desc,
    j4.area_code,
    j4.area_desc,
    j4.district_code,
    j4.district_desc,
    j4.region_code,
    j4.region_desc,
    j4.city,
    j4.state,
    j4.fs_open_dat,
    j4.rx_open_dat,
    j4.rx_division_code,
    j4.rx_area_code,
    j4.rx_region_code,
    j4.rx_district_code,
    j4.cal_store_week_number,
    j4.fs_comp_wk,
    j4.rx_comp_wk,
    j4.zrwstrtdate,
    j4.zrwenddate,
    pct.profit_center_text
  FROM
    Join_4 j4
    LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT pct
      ON j4.b631_s_proftctr = pct.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 15: FLAGS
-- Logic: Applies the FLAGS projection from CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC.
--        Computes:
--          cal_fs_rx_flag = CASE(LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1,2),'FS'->'FS','RX'->'RX',else '')
--          cal_comp_flag  = IF(ISNULL(CASE(cal_fs_rx_flag,'FS'->fs_comp_wk,
--                             'RX'->rx_comp_wk, else fs_comp_wk)),'0', ...)
--          cal_week_number = RIGHT(bic_zio_sweek, 2)
--          b631_s_amount   = b631_s_amount_negative * -1
-- Source: Join_5
-- Calculation: cal_fs_rx_flag, cal_comp_flag, cal_week_number, b631_s_amount
-- =====================================================================
FLAGS AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    recordmode,
    currency,
    b631_s_amount_negative,
    bic_zio_amt,
    flag,
    parnode,
    strnum,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    cal_store_week_number,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate,
    profit_center_text,
    -- CAL_FS_RX_FLAG: CASE(LEFTSTR(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1,2),'FS','FS','RX','RX','')
    CASE
      WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'FS' THEN 'FS'
      WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'RX' THEN 'RX'
      ELSE ''
    END AS cal_fs_rx_flag,
    -- CAL_COMP_FLAG: IF(ISNULL(CASE(CAL_FS_RX_FLAG,...)),'0',CASE(...))
    CASE
      WHEN (
        CASE
          WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'FS' THEN fs_comp_wk
          WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'RX' THEN rx_comp_wk
          ELSE fs_comp_wk
        END
      ) IS NULL THEN '0'
      ELSE (
        CASE
          WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'FS' THEN fs_comp_wk
          WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'RX' THEN rx_comp_wk
          ELSE fs_comp_wk
        END
      )
    END AS cal_comp_flag,
    -- CAL_WEEK_NUMBER: RIGHTSTR(_BIC_ZIO_SWEEK, 2)
    RIGHT(bic_zio_sweek, 2) AS cal_week_number,
    -- _B631_S_AMOUNT (final): _B631_S_AMOUNT_NEGATIVE * -1
    (b631_s_amount_negative * -1) AS b631_s_amount
  FROM
    Join_5
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT
-- Logic: Aggregation layer of CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC (CUBE /
--        outputViewType="Aggregation"). GROUP BY all non-measure columns;
--        SUM() on measure columns b631_s_amount_negative, bic_zio_amt,
--        b631_s_amount. Calculated columns (cal_fs_rx_flag, cal_comp_flag,
--        cal_week_number, b631_s_amount) are computed before aggregation
--        in FLAGS CTE and then summed/grouped as appropriate.
--        Output aliases follow BigQuery style per Columns_Mapping.
-- Source: FLAGS
-- Aggregation: GROUP BY all non-measure columns; SUM measures
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  mandt,
  fiscper,
  fiscvarnt,
  fiscyear,
  fiscper3,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  b631_s_chrtacct,
  b631_s_co_area,
  bic_zio_cmpcd,
  b631_s_proftctr,
  b631_s_costcntr,
  b631_s_funcarea,
  bic_zio_ver,
  bic_zio_saudt,
  b631_s_gl_acct,
  bic_zwwpc_pa1,
  bic_zwwsc_pa1,
  currency,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  cal_fs_rx_flag          AS fs_rx_flag,
  cal_comp_flag           AS comp_flag,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  strnum,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  cal_week_number,
  city,
  state,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  flag                    AS fin_bud_cube,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  SUM(b631_s_amount_negative) AS b631_s_amount_negative,
  SUM(bic_zio_amt)            AS bic_zio_amt,
  SUM(b631_s_amount)          AS b631_s_amount
FROM
  FLAGS
GROUP BY
  mandt,
  fiscper,
  fiscvarnt,
  fiscyear,
  fiscper3,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  b631_s_chrtacct,
  b631_s_co_area,
  bic_zio_cmpcd,
  b631_s_proftctr,
  b631_s_costcntr,
  b631_s_funcarea,
  bic_zio_ver,
  bic_zio_saudt,
  b631_s_gl_acct,
  bic_zwwpc_pa1,
  bic_zwwsc_pa1,
  currency,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  cal_fs_rx_flag,
  cal_comp_flag,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  strnum,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  cal_week_number,
  city,
  state,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  flag,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
